title: Keep Clipboard Manager service going when clipboard tray icon disabled
line: Clipboard history keeps working, and copied text survives the app that copied it quitting, even when the Clipboard entry is disabled in the system tray.
explanation: Klipper (clipboard history and persistence) is a shared singleton in libklipper that is only created when the clipboard applet's QML plugin asks for it, and it is destroyed when the last applet goes away. Disabling or removing the Clipboard entry in the system tray therefore also removed org.kde.klipper, so anything copied vanished when the app that copied it quit. ShellCorona now takes its own reference to Klipper::self() at startup, so the service runs in plasmashell regardless of the applet, and the applet keeps using the same instance.

commits.message:
shell: keep the clipboard manager running without the clipboard applet

Klipper only lived as long as a clipboard applet held it, so disabling
the Clipboard entry in the system tray also stopped clipboard history and
persistence. plasmashell now keeps its own reference to Klipper instead.

BUG: 423625

media.caption: Clipboard entry disabled in the tray: org.kde.klipper is not running, and after the copying app quits wl-paste says "Nothing is copied".
Same setup with the fix: org.kde.klipper runs without the tray entry, and the text is still pasteable after the copying app quits.
